IPL Trade Rumors: Hardik Pandya Linked to Chennai Super Kings

Reports suggest cricketer Hardik Pandya may be traded to Chennai Super Kings (CSK) for the next IPL season. CSK has reportedly offered a package including players Shivam Dube and Dewald Brevis, along with INR 10-20 crore. The Mumbai Indians are reportedly considering this offer, with one condition reportedly holding up the deal. Former cricketer Aakash Chopra has commented on the potential trade.
